notes:
- **The portable version updates itself now.** If you run Unseen Media from
  the portable zip rather than the installer, it showed the update banner but
  never actually updated: *Restart & update* closed the app and it stayed on
  the old version. **Download the portable zip from this release once and
  replace your folder with it** — from then on it updates itself like the
  installed version. If your copy lives somewhere it can't change (such as
  Program Files), the banner gives you a download link instead.

---
Windows updates itself on the next launch. Linux updates through your system updater if you installed 2.6.8 or newer; if you are on an older version, download the `.deb` below and install it once more.
